description: This Java source file defines an abstract class DataValidator for validating data objects within the Thingsboard project. It includes validation methods for email, queue names, domain names, and size limits, and manages validation logic for data creation, update, and deletion.

classes.name: DataValidator
classes.description: An abstract class providing validation methods for data objects, including email, queue names, domain names, and size constraints, used within the Thingsboard data management system.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a data object, checking for null, field correctness, and whether it is a create or update operation.

methods.name: validateDataImpl
methods.description: Placeholder for additional data-specific validation logic.

methods.name: validateCreate
methods.description: Hook for validation logic during creation of data.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Hook for validation logic during update of data.

methods.name: validateString
methods.description: Validates that a string is not blank and does not contain null characters.

methods.name: isSameData
methods.description: Checks if two data objects are the same based on their IDs.

methods.name: doValidateEmail
methods.description: Performs regex validation of email address.

methods.name: validateNumberOfEntitiesPerTenant
methods.description: Checks if the tenant has exceeded entity limits.

methods.name: validateMaxSumDataSizePerTenant
methods.description: Ensures total data size per tenant does not exceed maximum.

methods.name: validateJsonStructure
methods.description: Validates that JSON structure matches expected fields.

methods.name: validateQueueName
methods.description: Validates queue name against pattern and reserved names.

methods.name: validateQueueNameOrTopic
methods.description: Validates queue name or topic string against pattern.

methods.name: isValidDomain
methods.description: Checks if a domain name is valid, including localhost and domain regex.
